observations: Three photos show a complete engine and gearbox assembly on a concrete surface, likely in a workshop or yard.
The engine has a silver-colored cylinder head and block, with various hoses, pipes, and components attached.
The intake manifold and air filter housing are visible on the left side in photo 0 and photo 2.
The front of the engine shows the timing cover and pulleys, with a black plastic cover over part of the intake system.
The gearbox is attached to the rear of the engine, with a visible bell housing and mounting points.
There is visible grime, oil residue, and wear on the engine and surrounding area.
No visible branding or model tags are readable on the engine block or cylinder head in any photo.
The watermark 'PATRICKAUTOS GLOBAL' is present on all photos, suggesting a seller or dealer name, not part of the engine itself.
Photo 0 and photo 2 are nearly identical, showing the same angle with slight differences in lighting and foot position.

claims.claim: Complete engine and gearbox for Toyota RX 300 highest grade.
claims.evidence: No visible branding or model identifiers on the engine or gearbox in any photo. The seller's claim cannot be confirmed from the images alone.

risks.risk: The engine may not be from a Toyota RX 300, or may be from a different model or year.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine block or cylinder head showing the model number or casting marks, or a photo of the gearbox with its model identifier.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic engine and gearbox assembly, not as a specific Toyota RX 300 unit.

risks.risk: The engine may be damaged, worn, or not in working condition.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the engine running, or a close-up of the internal components (e.g., cylinder walls, crankshaft, bearings) to assess wear.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working or in unknown condition, which reduces value significantly.

risks.risk: The gearbox may be mismatched or incompatible with the engine.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the gearbox housing showing the model or transmission type, and a photo of the engine-to-gearbox mating surface to confirm compatibility.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic gearbox, which may not fit the intended vehicle.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the engine block or cylinder head showing model number or casting marks.
Clear photo of the gearbox housing showing model or transmission type.
Video or photo of the engine running, if possible.
Photo of the engine-to-gearbox mating surface to confirm compatibility.
response.reason: The seller claims the item is a complete engine and gearbox for a Toyota RX 300, but no model identifiers are visible in the photos. Without proof of the model, brand, or condition, the item cannot be accurately priced. The risks of mismatch, damage, or incorrect model are high and must be verified before pricing.
